relationship: Supplement to the unchanged August 17 deterministic vector protocol; no retrospective rewrite of earlier evidence.
generator_freeze: Generator and seed frozen before the first run. Sanitizer assurance withdrawn for that initial Zig run; rerun the identical generator with demonstrated ASAN and UBSAN positive controls.
input_method: Deterministic xorshift32; arbitrary bytes, generated Ethernet/single-VLAN/IPv4/TCP/UDP templates, byte mutations and prefix truncations.
properties: No ASAN or UBSAN diagnostic for generated inputs after both deliberate-fault controls detect their faults.
Parse status and policy action stay within their declared enums.
Malformed and truncated packets are dropped.
Fragmented packets do not expose valid transport ports.
Valid ports belong only to TCP or UDP.
Repeated parsing returns the same initialized view.
Parser and policy path agree on parse status.
Fresh per-packet parse and action counters each partition one observed packet.
stop_rule: Stop on the first invariant failure or sanitizer error. Explicit invariant failures retain case index and declared frame bytes. Sanitizer failures retain diagnostics and the deterministic seed/count; frame capture is not guaranteed for sanitizer aborts.
toolchain_gate: Use the same identified sanitizer compiler and flags for deliberate heap-overflow and signed-overflow controls, deterministic vectors and generated cases; each control must exit nonzero with its expected diagnostic.
